description: This file declares functions related to computing gradients symbolically within TensorFlow's C++ API. It provides interface functions for adding gradient nodes to computational graphs and a utility for representing no-gradient scenarios.
external_methods: absl::Status AddSymbolicGradients(const Scope&, const std::vector<Output>&, const std::vector<Output>&, const std::vector<Output>&, std::vector<Output>*)
absl::Status AddSymbolicGradients(const Scope&, const std::vector<Output>&, const std::vector<Output>&, std::vector<Output>*)

methods.name: AddSymbolicGradients
methods.description: Computes symbolic gradients for a set of outputs and inputs, adding gradient nodes to the graph within the provided scope. Handles initial gradients and outputs the gradients of the inputs.

methods.name: AddSymbolicGradients (overload)
methods.description: Computes symbolic gradients assuming 'OnesLike' for all outputs, simplifying gradient initialization.

methods.name: NoGradient
methods.description: Returns a sentinel Output representing the absence of a gradient signal (used to halt backpropagation at that point).
